thesis: 핵심 사업·재무 수치는 대부분 SEC 10-Q/8-K로 직접 검증돼 증거 기반은 강하다. 다만 밸류에이션 5년 백분위 0.05와 AS 확률은 모델/2차자료 추정이고, Rubin 30x/35x는 회사 제공 workload-specific benchmark다. 추가 감리에서 고객·파트너 보증의 최대 총노출이 $108.5B로 확인돼 기존 digest의 '보증 최대손실 미확인'은 보완됐다. DCF는 재현 가능하지만 owner-FCF 경로가 핵심 추정치다.

evidence.claim: Q2 FY27 revenue $96.221B, Data Center revenue $89.0B and the $108B Q3 guide are directly supported by NVIDIA's SEC-furnished 8-K exhibits and 10-Q.

The $366B future-commitment total and $279B supply/capacity commitment are explicitly disclosed in the Q2 FY27 10-Q, including a statement that some supply arrangements may be cancelable, reschedulable or adjustable before firm orders.

CFO commentary discloses maximum gross guarantee exposure of $108.5B, including $3.5B land/power/shell guarantees for AI clouds and $105.0B of SB Energy guarantees; this materially improves previously incomplete guarantee-risk evidence.

Accounts receivable concentration and customer financing risk are primary-source facts: five direct customers were 22%, 14%, 13%, 11%, and 10% of AR, while DSO rose to 60 days from 45 due to extended payment terms.

Rubin's 30x throughput-per-MW and 35x lower token-cost claims are attributable to NVIDIA's own earnings-call/technical materials rather than independent customer benchmarking, so they should not be treated as independently validated TCO facts.

counterevidence: The most decision-relevant revenue, balance-sheet, commitment and customer-concentration figures are all primary-source disclosures, limiting basic data-quality risk.
The harness DCF mechanically locks discount rate and terminal multiples, reducing provider-specific arithmetic drift even though FCF paths remain estimates.
NVIDIA reports effective disclosure controls and no material Q2 change in internal control over financial reporting.
The $108.5B guarantee figure is gross maximum exposure, not an expected loss, so it should not be treated as debt-equivalent without probability and recovery assumptions.
unknowns: Expected-loss distribution and collateral/recourse terms behind the $108.5B gross guarantee exposure
Independent customer-level Rubin TCO/ROI versus vendor benchmark claims
A statistically defined five-year valuation percentile using one consistent valuation metric
falsifiers: If independent customer economics fail to confirm a material Rubin TCO advantage by FY28, reduce structural/product confidence.
If DSO/AR concentration and gross guarantee exposure rise for several quarters while FCF conversion weakens, reject the 'high-quality self-funded demand' assumption.
If normalized owner-FCF/share misses the Base path for two fiscal years without a corresponding valuation reset, rewrite the valuation thesis.

key_kpis.name: Financing-supported demand quality
key_kpis.threshold: DSO/AR concentration and guarantee exposure do not compound materially faster than revenue/FCF

key_kpis.name: Normalized owner FCF/share
key_kpis.threshold: Track at or above the Base path after working-capital normalization

key_kpis.name: Independent Rubin TCO/ROI
key_kpis.threshold: Customer/third-party evidence confirms material system-level savings versus alternatives
